dedupe_keys.name: koya hybrid indoor positioning wi fi inertial and cctv dataset

description: Koya University publishes a multimodal dataset for indoor positioning in a third-floor engineering-building corridor. The article describes Wi-Fi signal strengths, smartphone accelerometer, gyroscope and magnetometer readings, and CCTV observations with person and door annotations. Measurements follow a one-metre grid along a thirty-nine-by-forty-nine-metre corridor, with repeated readings and images at two-metre intervals. Zenodo provides one named RAR archive free under CC BY 4.0, but its record has no descriptive abstract or detailed enclosed-file inventory. Coverage is one building floor and a single smartphone, with exact dates unestablished. Limited access points and camera positions constrain generalisation. A reviewer-assessed use is checking sensor-fusion and indoor-movement assumptions in building digital-twin simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related communications simulator, without verified multimodal integration. The article supplies context missing from the deposit; no images, archive or positioning model was downloaded or executed.
